name: Amour in the Abbey
source:
This is a romantic visual novel about lesbian nuns.

The game is inspired by nuns in the Catholic church during in the Medieval period. 

[From [url=https://morgis.itch.io/amour-in-the-abbey]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部关于女同性恋修女的浪漫视觉小说。

该游戏的灵感来自中世纪时期天主教堂的修女。

[来自[url=https://morgis.itch.io/amour-in-the-abbey]Itch.io[/url]]
